Class BillAdjustmentTriggerHandler

public with sharing class BillAdjustmentTriggerHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Trigger handler for the BillAdjustment__c object. Replicates parent Adjustment__c field values on insert and executes declarative lookup rollup summaries (DLRS) on insert, update, delete, and undelete.
